This line is unchanged by the current diff (present before and after the third-slide cut), and it is a low-harm instance, not a severe one: the file is explicitly a "container" map-reveal opener whose entire job (per the maintainer's STATUS and Container-discipline notes) is orientation, the clause ties to the CURRENT module's own imminent action rather than a distant future beat, and the maintainer has already applied this exact discipline twice on this file (the L39 recap-bullet cut and the L33 third-slide cut).
